audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose was generic and Taliyah was called 'he/his' in eight fields; the page never named what actually makes the lane dangerous for a dash champion.
audit.why: Unraveled Earth stuns enemies that dash through it. LeBlanc's entire pattern is a dash in and a dash back, so her minefield is the one thing in the kit that punishes the champion's core mechanic — and it appeared nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Lane is LeBlanc's at every stage (packet chart is LeBlanc 7/7), but the losing line is W-dashing across her mines rather than losing a trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose named the levels but gave no cooldown to key off — packet defect flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: Seismic Shove 14/12.5/11/9.5/8, Unraveled Earth a flat 14s, Weaver's Wall 180/150/120 are the numbers every step-up should be measured against.
audit.corrected: Step up on Seismic Shove's 14-second rank-1 downtime; her level 6 is a 180-second reposition, not a burst answer, so your 6 beats hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive ability interaction was entirely absent: LeBlanc's W (and the W return) dashing through Unraveled Earth triggers the mines and stuns her.
audit.why: Riot text: 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' It is 950 range and a flat 14s. Seismic Shove can also knock you into it, which is the combo the page called 'her whole setup' without ever saying what it does.
audit.corrected: Never W across mined ground, out or back. Wait the 14s or take a path around it. Weaver's Wall is terrain and can cut the W return path outright.

audit.why: It is the field that carries the real numbers.
audit.corrected: Seismic Shove 14 to 8, Unraveled Earth 14 flat, Weaver's Wall 180 at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement: content win[0..6] read LeBlanc on all seven rows while every full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is LeBlanc on all seven rows and matches the content layer, so the full layer is stale.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side set to LeBlanc with every why rewritten in the same proposal.

notes: The decisive interaction was missing from the entire page and is now on it: LeBlanc's W dash — and the W return — triggers Unraveled Earth and gets stunned, which is the one thing in Taliyah's kit built to punish this champion's core pattern. Seismic Shove knocking you into her own mines is the same combo the page kept calling 'her whole setup' without ever saying what it did. Weaver's Wall is terrain and can sever the W return path; that is also new to the page. Eight MISGENDER findings fixed (Taliyah is she/her). Cross-layer chart fixed: all seven phases[N].side were 'Skill' while win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read LeBlanc on every row; win[N] already correct so no content chart edits were needed, and all seven whys were rewritten in the same proposal. phases[N].rating left alone — I cannot determine from the data whether it means owner-favourability or difficulty. Packet defect 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' is addressed by the rewritten breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, whys[3] and mid, which all key off Seismic Shove's 14s and Unraveled Earth's flat 14s. Three report entries touched, every one of them an explicit lint MISGENDER finding. NOTE ON A DERIVED-FLAG MISFIRE: the kit file tags Threaded Volley (Q) with 'grounding' and 'hardCC', but Riot's own description for that ability mentions only damage and a slow on Worked Ground — no ground and no hard CC. I wrote nothing asserting either, per the rule that the description outranks a derived flag. breakdown.wave and breakdown.carry judged templated but not grounded, left as-is.
